summary: PARKED — built as specified, work preserved in the working tree, NOT landed; Card 2 (mms-send-on-signup, the MMS send) should not start on it. WHAT IS BUILT AND PROVEN: migration 0088 (identity hash + minted-at on subscribers, the identity_media image table, cascade-deleted with the subscriber) with its Down run; MintIdentityCode (idempotent, 16-char token, only its sha256 stored, Low/512 PNG, identity-only payload with no #o= when there is no first-touch campaign); public GET+HEAD /m/{id}.png; ProjectIdentityCode (POST /codes, merge-duplicates, uuid-v5 id per subscriber); the import mints every NEW subscriber after its commit and answers warnings:["not_projected"] when a campaign-bearing code could not be projected; GET /subscribers/{id} reports not_minted|minted|sent plus media_url; #scan-file-surface 320→640. RAN / OBSERVED: red-first shown (Go: build failure, exit 1; Playwright: 3 failed on the pre-change tree and the pre-change binary answers /m/<uuid>.png 404); the five named Go tests plus four riders 9/9 pass with NO egress-allowlist change; go build + vet exit 0; full Go suite -p 1 under the lock: 15 packages ok, 463 top-level pass / 0 fail / 3 skip (opt-in live-substrate legs), TestRowVisibilityRLS pass; marketing seam subset with no retries: 132 tests, 131 pass, 1 fail ([IC-03]); repo-hygiene 5/5. Nothing is sent and no provider is reachable from this diff (no sender exists in it); the PostgREST in the projection test is an httptest stub, [IC-02]'s server lookup is the one permitted page.route stub, subscribers come from the committed Fluent Forms fixture. WHY IT IS PARKED: the signed encoding correction (Low/version-9 reads from a photo, Medium/version-11 does not, widening the surface buys headroom) rests on one symbol per variant and does not hold. Measured over 250 freshly drawn codes through the shipped page's vendored decoder (logs/identity-code-and-qr/density-probe.log): the card's own code is read 212/250 (85%) — about one customer code in seven is not read from a pristine image, and the same code fails every time; the Medium 'negative control' is read 208/250 (83%), i.e. as often; the same codes fail at every surface width from 320 to 1280 px, so the 640 px change does nothing measurable; even a bare identity-only code is read only ~94%. No decode ever produced another customer's token. So gate [IC-03] as signed is false on most runs (it passed once and failed once tonight, on different tokens), and [IC-01]/[IC-02] pass only when the token just minted happens to be a readable one — with the config's one retry (which mints a new token) they would mostly pass and hide it. I did not rewrite the gates or pin a token to get a green. NOT MEASURED: the live-camera path (no gate exercises it) and any other decoder. OPERATOR QUESTION: As the owner, I want every customer who is sent a code to be readable at the window, so that nobody holding a valid code is turned away. Tonight's measurement says 'Scan from photo' misses roughly 1 code in 7 as designed (1 in 17 with no offer inside), and that the correction level and surface size you signed off on do not change that. Which do you want: (A) land this as built, treat photo-scan as best-effort and rely on the live camera, with [IC-03] dropped and [IC-01]/[IC-02] restated as what is true; (B) put less in the QR — without the campaign id the read rate is ~97%, but the tablet then cannot tie an offline offer to its campaign; (C) fix the scanner's photo decoder first (it is the shipped reader that fails, even on the simplest code), then land this unchanged; or (D) have the server check each code is readable before issuing it and redraw until it is, which needs a decoder on the server that this repo does not have. My recommendation is C, with an attended camera test at the truck before any of them, because the floor is in the reader and not in this card's encoding. ALSO FOR TRIAGE: engineer-level calls made and listed in the merge-intent note for ratification (a long offer line is shortened inside the QR so the symbol never exceeds version 10; media_url is a relative path; the QR's expiry is the UTC date; a second warning identity_not_minted; projections stop after the first failure in one import); out-of-footprint edits stated there (playwright.config.js gains HQ_FF_FIXTURE_PATH so the e2e server can import the committed fixture; routes_test.go's public-surface guard now pins four routes; one status assertion each in subscribers_test.go and marketing-subscribers.spec.js moves from not_sent to minted); a known gap (a code minted but not projected is never re-projected, and pre-existing subscribers get no code); the roadmap line is left PLANNED and the night-crew.toml roll-call comment left at 7 because nothing landed; sw.js and version.json are not in the diff; the B-486 screenshot-restore rule is one directory short — the seam leg also rewrote seven committed PNGs under runs/2026-10-02-autonomous/logs/h5/states/ (restored). OWED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR if this is ever landed: sw.js regeneration + count 51, and the full Playwright suite.
